description: List the events you're part of (as host or guest). Defaults to upcoming events; pass past:true for events that have already happened. Optionally filter by a search query.

past.description: Return past events instead of upcoming (default false).

skip.description: Number of items to skip, for paging (default 0).

view.description: "full" (default) returns Vibo's payload as it arrived; "brief" returns one line per event: title — <ISO date | no date> — <your role>, <open|locked>, inside the untrusted-data envelope, with "-- none" for no events and "-- N of M shown" / "-- more" when the page is partial.

name: vibo_list_events
